email.description: The email address of the user.

first_name.description: The first name of the user.

last_name.description: The last name of the user.

email_verified.description: Whether the user's email has been verified.

metadata.description: Object containing metadata key/value pairs associated with the user.

external_id.description: The external ID of the user.

password.description: The password to set for the user. Mutually exclusive with `password_hash` and `password_hash_type`.

password_hash.description: The hashed password to set for the user. Required with `password_hash_type`. Mutually exclusive with `password`.

password_hash_type.description: The algorithm originally used to hash the password, used when providing a `password_hash`. Required with `password_hash`. Mutually exclusive with `password`.
